name: Rose&burlap Vintage Boho Floral Bread Box Double Layer(Wildflowers)
intro: Floral; Botanical; Vintage Boho; Whimsical; Cottagecore;  Earth Tones; Decorative; Unique; Antique; Vintage
description: 「KEEPS BREAD FRESH」Designed to maintain optimal conditions for storing sourdough bread, keeping it crust crackly for 3 days.
「VINTAGE BOHO」The combination of olive green, mustard yellow, dusty pink, and brick red delivers a warm, nostalgic visual aesthetic, creating a relaxed and airy living ambiance.
「SPACIOUS INTERIOR」The upper layer offers 4.72'' of clearance and the bottom layer 6.50'', there's plenty of room to fit full-sized loaves, rolls, bagels, and all your favorite baked goods with ease.
「EASY TO MOVE」A thoughtfully designed bottom pull doubles as a handy grip, so the bread box slides and lifts easily across your countertop.
「EASY CARE」Made of 100% Bamboo, Humidity of 40–60% would help keep it dry. Clean by wiping with a soft damp (not soaking) cloth and do not immerse in water or place in a dishwasher.
